key_insight: InfiMed2 is a stage-aware medical multimodal foundation model that improves performance by matching data type and supervision style to each training phase.
clinical_relevance: The model is designed to better answer medical image-and-text questions with more informative, answer-consistent responses, which may support clinical decision workflows and education.
method: Curated a 55.68B-token multimodal medical corpus combining broad clinical knowledge and context-rich visual evidence.
Used a three-stage CPT pipeline: vision encoder adaptation, broad medical knowledge building, then evidence-focused data mixing during learning-rate decay.
Regenerated VQA supervision with answer stability, masked reconstruction, and correctness-constrained selection; the 4B model also used RLVR.
evidence_signal: Across five medical multimodal benchmarks, InfiMed2-4B reached 66.73% mean accuracy after RLVR and InfiMed2-27B reached 73.72%, the best among evaluated open-weight models.
watch_item: Performance is benchmark-based, so real-world robustness, safety, and generalization to unseen clinical settings still need careful validation.
paper_title: InfiMed2: A Generalist Medical Multimodal Foundation Model from Contextual Evidence and Stability-Aware Supervision
